## 5a54c427d30d

**Reproduced defect — distinct requested 9-counts can collapse to a tied minimum.** At `seed=39, sample_index=8, difficulty=None`, `_draw_nine_counts` requests `[9,10,11,12]` while all four shapes are 3x3. `generate()` clips each count with `min(n9, len(local_cells))`, so every block becomes nine cells of color 9, all four realized counts are 9, all major colors disappear, and `self_check` reports `minimum 9-count is tied`. This violates the summary and invariants and makes the intended unique choice unavailable. The sweep found 2 invalid ordinary generations among 6,000 draws; the second was `hard, seed=109, sample_index=1`. The selected Racket authority (`20f71cbdee8e`) still erases one arbitrarily selected tied component, confirming that the generated lesson has no unique semantic target. Reproducer, captured requested counts/shapes, exact grid, authority output, and census: `checks/audit/5a54c427d30d/repro_tied_min.py`, `tied_min_evidence.json`, `authority-input.json`, `authority-output.json`, and the corresponding logs.

The direct repair is to select counts conditional on each realized block area (and reserve at least one major-color cell), or redraw the whole instance until realized counts are distinct with a unique minimum; `self_check` should remain a hard postcondition rather than merely a diagnostic. The public lint stage additionally fails because `RULE_HASH` is missing (`checks/audit/5a54c427d30d/lint/`). No audit-target source was edited.
